subject: F4 parent-directory preflight inconsistency at P-1-session scope

path_decomposition.terminal_parent_existence_source: user/PA statement of 2026-10-27; NOT host-captured by this record

the_inconsistency.requirement_document_character: readiness checklist / procedure template prepared by the preparing capacity; explicitly 'not an execution receipt, qualification result or acceptance' (line 16)
the_inconsistency.PF-13_text: parent exists and is local fixed NTFS; not a cloud-synced or network path
the_inconsistency.PF-12_text: False; the path is recorded verbatim; no directory/file is created by preflight

implementation.effect: the terminal parent is created automatically when the authorized P-1 execution opens the store

contradiction: PF-13 requires the terminal parent to exist at P-1 preflight time.
PF-12 forbids the preflight from creating any directory or file on the store path.
The only authorized actor that creates the terminal parent is the single P-1 execution itself, which runs only after that preflight passes.
Therefore PF-13 as literally worded is unsatisfiable without violating PF-12; the deadlock is self-referential and was introduced by the preparing capacity, not by the PA.

step_1_conditions: file must not pre-exist (Test-Path = False, recorded verbatim)

pf15_pa_act_defers_characteristics_not_e.reading: the PA act declines to claim the parent's filesystem characteristics and requires those characteristics to be checked on the host under the governing P-1 procedure; it does not require the parent to pre-exist.

dispositions.title: PF-13 at P-1-session scope is evaluated at the nearest existing ancestor
dispositions.rule: PF-13 is satisfied at P-1-session scope when the nearest existing ancestor of $StorePath is local fixed NTFS and is not a cloud-synchronized or network location. The terminal parent C:\iips-data\iips need not pre-exist; its absence is not a STOP.
dispositions.creation_authority: The terminal parent is created by the authorized single P-1 execution (connection.ts line 84, recursive mkdir) and by nothing else. Pre-creating it is NOT authorized and remains a STOP.
dispositions.s3_scope_unchanged: At S3 scope PF-13 keeps its original text: after P-1 the terminal parent MUST exist, and it is then inspected directly. This disposition does not relax S3.
safety_content_preserved_by: PF-11 (local fixed NTFS, unsynchronized, outside every worktree, writable without elevation)
PF-12 (store and sidecars absent; nothing created by preflight)
dispositions.authority_basis: preparing-capacity correction of its own readiness checklist to conform to the PA-level successor act step 1 and to the shipped implementation; no PA-rendered value, pin, fence or gate is changed

dispositions.title: PF-12's 'no directory/file is created' binds the store path, not the evidence root
dispositions.rule: PF-12 prohibits creating any directory or file on $StorePath or its ancestor chain. It does not prohibit creating the PF-14 evidence root or writing capture transcripts there.
dispositions.rationale: PF-12 and PF-14 would otherwise be jointly unsatisfiable: capturing a transcript requires somewhere to write it, and PF-14 is the sanctioned location.
dispositions.not_relaxed: No store file, sidecar or store-path ancestor may be created by preflight.

dispositions.title: P-1 step-2 pre-state on a correctly absent store is the STORE_NOT_FOUND refusal
dispositions.rule: Because PF-12 requires $StorePath to be absent, --mode=validate at step 2 refuses with STORE_NOT_FOUND (exit 1). That refusal, recorded verbatim, is the pre-state evidence and satisfies successor-act step 2's intent: an absent store cannot contain a pre-existing ACTIVE row.
dispositions.anomaly_rule: A SUCCESSFUL validate report at step 2 is the anomaly: it proves the store pre-existed, contradicts PF-12, and is a STOP before any execute invocation.
dispositions.authority_basis: interpretation that makes the PA act's own step 2 executable without relaxing any safety condition; the reading is stricter, not weaker

observations.title: P-1 CLI accepts only --flag=value
observations.detail: parseGateAPrimeArguments/requiredOption reject space-separated forms with ARGUMENT_INVALID. The runbook block at lines 84-89 uses --act-id <ACT_ID>, --store <ABS_PATH>, --principal-label <v> etc. and would fail on substitution. The capture instrument uses the '=' form.
